documentation.content: A non-core Cloud Function logged an ERROR (severity>=ERROR), excluding the three watched by 'Toska — critical function error' (validatePost / onUserDocDeleted / sendPushNotification) and benign self-retrying logs ('will retry'). This is the broad net that catches silent failures in scheduled / maintenance / moderation functions — e.g. pruneOldNotifications and checkReportSLA, both of which failed silently in July 2026. Open the named function's logs for the traceback.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: severity>=ERROR AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND NOT resource.labels.service_name=("validatepost" OR "onuserdocdeleted" OR "sendpushnotification") AND NOT "will retry"
